_doc: Generator lines, en (AL-52, mirror of ru say.json from AL-51, DIALOGUE_GEN §5, LOC v0.2). Key say.<act>.<situation>, value: an array of variants (picked by seed). Which key is said is decided by the rules in content/ai/dialogue_rules/*.json. Arguments: speaker, listener (with reg and addr), prop (the proposition said), src (whom the speaker heard it from, the nearest link of the chain), reason (refusal reason: a misdeed proposition or a string), item, price. part.epi.* are shared epistemic openers for own lines and mods. Register: plain rustic English with a light archaic touch; nobles get 'my lord / my lady'.
part.epi.seen: I saw it with my own eyes
As God is my witness, I saw it
part.epi.rumor_lo: The wives at the well whisper that
say.inform.seen: With my own eyes I saw it: {>prop}.
I was there and saw it all: {>prop}.
Not some tale from others, this: {>prop}.
say.inform.seen_victim: You ought to know, {listener}: {>prop}. I saw it myself.
I'd rather not say it, but I must: {>prop}.
say.inform.rumor_mid: Word is {>prop}. Might even be true.
There's a rumour that {>prop}. I didn't see it myself.
say.inform.rumor_lo: Can't say if it's true, but they babble that {>prop}.
Folk claim {>prop}. I wouldn't believe it.
say.inform.guess: I can't prove it, but I think {>prop}.
I've a hunch {>prop}. Don't ask me how.
say.inform.guess_theft: No thief till he's caught, but seems to me {>prop}.
Hand on heart, I didn't see it. But I think {>prop}.
Things don't walk off on their own. Seems to me {>prop}.
say.inform.inferred: I didn't see it, but it all points one way: {>prop}.
Put two and two together and you get it: {>prop}.
say.inform.grave_rumor: Have you heard? {>prop}. A dreadful business.
Evil times: {>prop}. Or so they say.
They whisper that {>prop}. Lord have mercy.
say.inform.loss: Have you heard? {>prop}. Someone had a hand in it, mark me.
say.ask.about: Tell me, do you know aught {>prop:about}?
say.ask.about_rude: Out with it, what do you know {>prop:about}.
Don't wriggle. What do you know {>prop:about}?
say.ask.about_noble: Begging your pardon, {listener:g|my lord|my lady}, what do you know {>prop:about}?
say.accuse.direct: It was you, I know it: {>prop}.
Everyone knows {>prop}. And so do I.
say.accuse.victim: {>prop}, and you dare look me in the eye?
say.accuse.seen: Don't deny it, I saw it myself: {>prop}.
say.accuse.unsure: Folk say {>prop}. What do you say to that?
There's talk that {>prop}. Is it true?
say.accuse.hostile: {>prop}, and you won't get away with it!
Why, you… {>prop}! I'll have your hide!
say.accuse.public: Let everyone hear: {>prop}. I demand judgement.
say.confess.prop: I can't keep quiet any longer: {>prop}.
say.confess.familiar: You're like kin to me, so hear it: {>prop}. Don't give me away.
say.apologize.prop: I know, {>prop}. How can I make it right?
say.apologize.noble: I humbly beg forgiveness, {listener:g|my lord|my lady}: {>prop}.
Bear me no grudge, {listener:g|my lord|my lady}: {>prop}, and I repent.
say.thank.prop: I won't forget it as long as I live: {>prop}.
I remember a kindness: {>prop}. Thank you.
say.praise.prop: I heard it: {>prop}. A good deed.
say.threaten.secret: Keep being stubborn and the whole village will learn that {>prop}.
I know that {>prop}. Think it over.
One word from me to the reeve and everyone will know: {>prop}.
say.lie.assert: I swear it, {>prop}. On anything you like.
say.lie.deny: Who's been spinning you tales? I had nothing to do with it.
You've got me mixed up with someone, {listener}.
say.greet.knows_thief: Oh, it's you… I keep my things under lock now.
Look who's come. Keep your hands where I can see them.
say.greet.remind_crime: Good day, if you mean it. Only I remember: {>prop}.
Well, look who turned up. And yet {>prop}.
say.greet.robbed_me: You! Give back what you stole!
You dare come near me, thief?
Pay back what you owe first, then say good day.
say.greet.saw_violence: Stay back. I saw you swinging your fists.
You… What do you want? And keep your hands to yourself.
say.greet.bad_name: Ah, {listener}. Folk say all sorts about you.
Well, good day. You've an ill name going round.
What do you want? I'd rather not be seen with you.
say.greet.liar: Ah, {listener}. Just don't lie to me today.
Come to spin more yarns, have you?
say.greet.good_name: {listener}! Glad to see you, good soul.
Good day, {listener}. I hear nothing but good of you.
Ah, {listener}! Come in, you're always welcome.
say.greet.pious_name: Peace be with you, {listener}. God keep you.
Good day, {listener}. Saw you at the altar, a good sign.
say.greet.helped_me: Ah, my saviour! Good day to you.
say.greet.noble: Good health to you, {listener:g|my lord|my lady}.
Good day, {listener:g|my lord|my lady}. How may I serve?
say.greet.elder: Good health, {listener}. How's the back, not aching?
say.greet.child: Hello, {listener:g|lad|lass}. Does your mother know where you're running about?
Ah, you little {listener:g|scamp|minx}. No mischief here.
say.farewell.noble: I won't keep you, {listener:g|my lord|my lady}.
say.farewell.thief: Off you go. And don't fill your pockets on the way.
Go on. I'll be keeping an eye on you.
say.refuse.misdeed: Not with you, never. Everyone remembers that {>reason}.
say.refuse.busy: No time, I've work enough of my own.
Not now, I'm up to my neck in work.
Later, later. Can't you see I'm busy?
say.refuse.enmity: I won't trade a single word with you.
For you? Sooner snow in summer.
say.refuse.fear_of_law: No. That's a spell in the stocks.
If the reeve finds out, I'm done for. I won't.
No, I'm fond of my own skin.
say.refuse.honest: That's against my conscience. I won't.
No. I live honestly, and I'd advise you the same.
say.refuse.hungry: Let me eat first, then we'll see.
Can't think of that on an empty belly.
My belly's growling, no time for errands.
say.refuse.low_affinity: You're no friend of mine, why should I bother?
say.refuse.loyalty_other: I gave my word, I can't break it.
I can't. Someone else is waiting on me.
say.refuse.no_authority: Why should I listen to you?
Order your own folk about, not me.
say.refuse.no_item: If I had {item}, I'd give it. I don't.
say.refuse.taboo: That's not how it's done here.
Our grandfathers never did that, and nor will I.
say.refuse.tired: I've no strength left, I'm dead on my feet.
Tomorrow. Today I'm no use to anyone.
I'm worn out, leave me be.
say.refuse.too_costly: I won't do it at a loss.
say.refuse.unfair_terms: For that, and so much? Are you mocking me?
No, we won't strike a deal like that.
say.refuse.unknown_topic: I don't know what you mean.
What are you even on about?
say.refuse.noble: Forgive me, {listener:g|my lord|my lady}, I cannot.
Don't be angry, {listener:g|my lord|my lady}, but it won't do.
say.outcome.fail.persuade: You sing sweetly, but you haven't swayed me.
say.outcome.fail.bargain: No, we won't strike a deal.
At that price, go find a fool.
Haggle all you like, my word stands.
say.outcome.fail.court: Off with you, sweetheart. You're not for me.
Your fine words don't please me.
say.outcome.fail.threaten: I'm not scared, try as you might.
say.outcome.fail.request: I won't give it. Don't even ask.
say.request.return_stolen: Give back what you took, and we'll part in peace.
Return what you stole and we'll forget it. For now.
I'm asking nicely: give me back what's mine.
say.bargain.thief_price: For you, double. For what you did.
For you, coin only, and up front.
A special price for you. You know why.
say.command.lead_child_away: Come on home, child. Nothing for you here.
Here, to me! Don't stand about with that one.
Home, now. And don't let me see you near strangers.
